NOMADS DMZ HUB: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ community tools

NOMADS DMZ HUB is an unofficial fan site for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ. The Gunsmith lets you pick a base weapon and test attachment builds with up to five attachment slots, showing each attachment name, unlock level and, where known, price.

The 3D printer crafting guide lists every recipe and upgrade with its ingredients. The interactive Hajin map has a legend to switch markers on and off and shows where to look for crafting ingredients and where the locked doors and keys are. The operator traits tree covers Warfighter, Scout and Survivalist.

Weapons in the Gunsmith

  • Assault Rifles: Han 86, M4, Hyeon Burst, Kastov 762, Patriot XMR, Oden, Axion, Cronen Squall
  • SMGs: ISO Nightshade, VEL 46, WZ.55 Striga, X-58 Nyx, PPSh-41
  • Shotguns: Rezi 12, Warlord
  • LMGs: Finn LMG, Type 73, APOC-338
  • Marksman Rifles: Mosin-Nagant, MAR-9, Oris 8.6
  • Sniper Rifles: KG-7 Vulcan, Signal 50, Astaroth .57
  • Pistols: Sang 9mm, Karit P68, .50 GS, Mojave .357
  • Launchers: PILA, RPG-8, JOKR, PM-40 Anvil
  • Melees: FSS Carbon Edge 1095

Attachment slots

DMZ rules: Gunsmith unlocks at DMZ Level 10. Extract a Weapon Manual to unlock buying that base weapon (it also pays 5,000 DMZ Cash). Base weapons start with no attachments: buy up to five attachment slots, each costing more than the last, plus the attachments themselves. The Apex slot opens after leveling the weapon. Looted Hajin weapons can carry up to eight. Fail to exfil and the weapon is lost.
Example: M4 build cart
  • Schlager Dogfight GI · Optic4,512
  • FSS IS300 · Muzzle9,025
  • 16" Highmark Barrel · Barrel4,512
  • FSS TAC90 Grip · Underbarrel4,987
  • PF1 Fixed Stock · Stock5,700
  • 4th attachment slot25,000
  • 5th attachment slot50,000
  • Build cost after 5% Gunsmith discount99,987

Base M4 is about 5,000 DMZ Cash. Blueprints are free to use once and lost for good if lost in a match (rebuy at a discount). Camos, stickers and charms cost nothing.

Attachment art is representative line work. Weapon and attachment stats will be added in a future update.
